# Animation library — production sheets

Every sheet below is **captured from the deterministic simulation** (`MoveAnimationCapture`), not typed by hand: when
move data changes, CI fails until this file is regenerated, so the animation contract and gameplay cannot drift.
Authoring rules, the rig and the review process are in [00-AnimationStandards.md](00-AnimationStandards.md).

**How to read a sheet**

- Frames are 1-based at 60 fps. The clip has exactly *Frames* frames; clip time *t* = (frame − 1) / 60 s.
- *Timeline* has one character per frame. `phase`: S startup, A active, g gap between hits, R recovery, `-` non-attack.
  `hitbox`: hit group number while a hitbox is live. `hurt`: s standing, c crouching, a airborne stance boxes,
  **upper case** when the move extends or replaces them. `defence`: I fully invulnerable, s/t/p strike/throw/projectile
  invulnerable, E perfect-evade window, K counter stance, A armor. `cancel`: c when a cancel window is open.
  Trigger lanes mark cue frames (`*` = several on one frame).
- *Root X/Y* is the captured root offset in metres at the end of each frame, run-length encoded (`0.10×5` = five
  frames at 0.10). Clips are authored **in place**; match foot contacts to this curve.
- *On contact* cues are fired by the simulation on the frame a hit lands (hitstop freezes the Contact pose).

### Fighter state clips — `fighter.rhen`

Played by `FighterPoseSampler` for every non-move state. *Loop* clips repeat; *FixedDuration* clips play once over the
listed frames (from the fighter data); *StunDuration* clips are authored at the reference length and time-warped to
the stun each hit applies; *VerticalVelocity* clips are sampled by vertical speed (take-off → apex → fall);
knock-out uses the story rules' hold (180 frames).

| Clip | Played in | Driver | Frames | Must show |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `A_Fighter_Idle` | Idle | Loop | 120 | Breathing combat guard, weapon ready; loop seamless; the pose every move starts and ends on. |
| `A_Fighter_WalkForward` | WalkForward | Loop | 60 | Four guarded steps covering 3.20 m (walk speed × loop), feet locked to the floor. |
| `A_Fighter_WalkBackward` | WalkBackward | Loop | 60 | Four retreating steps covering 2.60 m, guard kept high. |
| `A_Fighter_Crouch` | Crouch | Loop | 120 | Low stance under the crouching hurtbox height; loop. |
| `A_Fighter_GuardStand` | GuardStand | Loop | 90 | Standing block: weapon across the body, braced; loop. |
| `A_Fighter_GuardCrouch` | GuardCrouch | Loop | 90 | Crouching block: low guard covering the legs; loop. |
| `A_Fighter_PreJump` | PreJump | FixedDuration | 4 | Knees load before take-off; last frame is the push-off. |
| `A_Fighter_Airborne` | Airborne | VerticalVelocity | 30 | Jump strip sampled by vertical velocity: frame 1 = take-off, middle = apex tuck, last = falling ready to land. |
| `A_Fighter_Landing` | Landing | FixedDuration | 3 | Landing absorb (also used, time-warped, for the longer land-cancel recoveries). |
| `A_Fighter_ParryRecovery` | ParryRecovery | FixedDuration | 8 | Deflection follow-through after a perfect parry; returns to guard. |
| `A_Fighter_Blockstun` | Blockstun | StunDuration | 20 | Standing block impact: recoil in the first 4 frames, hold, recover to guard at the end. |
| `A_Fighter_BlockstunCrouch` | Blockstun (crouch guard) | StunDuration | 20 | Crouching block impact. |
| `A_Fighter_Hitstun` | Hitstun | StunDuration | 20 | Grounded hit reaction: snap in 3 frames, hold, recover; Phase 7 layers height/weight variants on top. |
| `A_Fighter_AirHitstun` | AirHitstun | StunDuration | 20 | Hit in the air: body jolts, recovers to the airborne fall pose. |
| `A_Fighter_Launched` | Launched | VerticalVelocity | 30 | Juggle tumble sampled by vertical velocity: rising spin, apex, falling face-up. |
| `A_Fighter_Stagger_GuardBreak` | Staggered (guard break) | StunDuration | 20 | Guard shattered: weapon knocked wide, off-balance, open to an execution. |
| `A_Fighter_Stagger_Parried` | Staggered (parried heavy) | StunDuration | 20 | Heavy attack deflected: weapon bounced back, body twisted open. |
| `A_Fighter_Knockdown_Soft` | Knockdown (soft) | FixedDuration | 32 | Fall and lie; the first frames overlap the tech-roll window, so the body must read as 'can still roll'. |
| `A_Fighter_Knockdown_Hard` | Knockdown (hard) | FixedDuration | 55 | Slammed flat, longer lie; no tech possible. |
| `A_Fighter_WakeUp` | WakeUp | FixedDuration | 22 | Rise to guard (fully invulnerable); last frame matches A_Fighter_Idle frame 1. |
| `A_Fighter_PairedVictim` | PairedVictim (fallback) | Loop | 60 | Generic held pose used only if a paired move has no victim clip. |
| `A_Fighter_KnockedOut` | KnockedOut | FixedDuration | 180 | Defeat collapse played over the knock-out hold. |
